integrity: The proof computes every irreducible-character kernel and codegree from the inversion action and then reconstructs each Sylow invariant from exact p-power order counts. A standalone checker independently verifies the pseudo-algebra and reconstruction formulas on eight finite abelian kernels.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes that the generalized-dihedral kernel has odd order.
Rigidity is proved within the generalized-dihedral family, not against arbitrary external finite groups.
The underlying irreducible-character parametrization is standard; the new content is the exact codegree multiplicity formula and reconstruction.
title: Generalized dihedral pseudo-algebras recover the odd abelian kernel
